positions.name: MeridianGateRequirement
positions.frame: What does the Meridian deployment gate require and what incident prompted it?
positions.why: src-1 and src-3 both state the signed-release-manifest requirement for Meridian deploys — one as narrative, one as a bullet — while src-2 supplies the motivating incident (two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter). The directional read holds all three: the gate's requirement read alongside its proximate cause.

positions.name: MeridianGateScope
positions.frame: What are the operational boundaries of the Meridian deployment gate?
positions.why: src-4 defines the environments the gate covers (staging and production) and src-5 names the owner accountable for the gate (Quinton Fairweather). Both are operational parameters of the same gate decision, read in the direction of its scope and accountability.
